oil.when: 2017 with the Driver Information Center controls on the right side of the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on.
Use the controls on the right side of the steering wheel to bring up REMAINING OIL LIFE on the cluster display.
Press and hold the select button (shown as a V symbol, the button that opens menus and selects items) for a few seconds.
The CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message clears and the oil life reads 100%.

oil.when: 2010–2012 with the MENU button on the turn signal lever
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Press the menu button on the turn signal lever to open the Vehicle Information menu.
Turn the thumbwheel to scroll to REMAINING OIL LIFE.
Press the SET/CLR button. The oil life resets to 100% and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
Turn the ignition to LOCK/OFF.
oil.note: Checked in the 2011 and 2012 owner's manuals; 2010 service information shows the same steps.

oil.when: 2007–2009 with a Driver Information Center (option and set/reset buttons)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on but leave the engine off.
Press the option button until ENGINE OIL MONITOR shows on the display.
Press the set/reset button. The next screen confirms the change oil message has been reset.
On cars with the uplevel display, you can press the gages button to check that OIL LIFE REMAINING reads 100%.
Turn the ignition off. If the light or message comes back, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2007 owner's manual and the 2009 Getting to Know Your LaCrosse guide.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the engine off, turn the key to RUN.
Slowly press the accelerator pedal all the way down and release it three times within five seconds.
Turn the key to OFF, then start the car.
If the change engine oil light comes back on, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2005 and 2007 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2005 with the Gauges and Set/Reset buttons (if equipped)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on and use the Gauges button to bring up OIL LIFE on the display.
While OIL LIFE is showing, press and hold the Set/Reset button until the display reads 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2005 Getting to Know Your LaCrosse guide. Cars without these buttons use a different method; see the owner's manual.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes off.
If the light comes on at a cold start and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low, so check all four with a gauge.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2017 owner's manual. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix.

notes: Even if the oil life system has not asked for a change, change the oil and filter at least once a year.
